scripts.infra: docker compose up -d postgres minio minio-init
scripts.infra:stop: docker compose stop postgres minio minio-init
scripts.swagger: cd apps/api && go run github.com/swaggo/swag/cmd/swag@v1.16.4 fmt -d ./cmd/server,./internal/handler && go run github.com/swaggo/swag/cmd/swag@v1.16.4 init -d ./cmd/server,./internal/handler -g main.go -o docs --parseInternal --parseDependency --parseDependencyLevel 1 --outputTypes go,json,yaml
